detail.title: First panel and second panel attaching method and display device
detail.abstract: The invention provides a first panel and second panel attaching method. A display device or a part of the display device is obtained after a first panel is attached to a second panel, and the superficial area of the first panel is larger than that of the second panel. The method comprises the steps of arranging removable protecting bars around the first panel, wherein the shape of the area defined by the protecting bars is matched with the shape of the second panel; arranging liquid transparent adhesive in the area defined by the protecting bars; attaching the first panel to the second panel; solidifying the liquid transparent adhesive; removing the protecting bars. The invention further provides a display device obtained with the method. Defects such as excessive adhesive will not occur on the display device or a part of the display device obtained with the method.
